ck: (5)sarkarasrinivasacarya vinatapataprayokaprayocanan vaktunaksipati — nanviti anse sitasatanatiti nanu yatranitye vananase ityatra paksatavacetakananatvan tatranitya vakiti puterutesyaya siteransata sitasatananiti nanikarenoktatvatatratnatvanekaneva paksatavacetakaniti katanansata sitasatananiti cet atra prastavyan kin paksatavacetakananatvanevanse sitasatane prayocakanutotesyapratitisitirapiti natya anvayato vyatirekatasca vyapicarat tatahi na tavat yatra paksatavacekananatvan tatranse sitasatananiti niyana vanaparvatO vahninantO tunatityatra vanaparvatatvarupapaksatavacetakananatvepyansata sitasatanapavat napi yatra paksatavacetakananatvapava tatranse sitasatanapava iti niyana travyanyanityani kunasrayapavat napi yatra paksatavacetakananatvapava tatranse sitasatanapava iti niyana travyanyanityani kunasrayatvat katavatityatra paksatavacekasya travyatvasyEkatvepi prtivyatikaryatravye anityatvasya sitatvenansata sitasatanasatpavat tvitiye tutesyapratitisitereva prayocakatvanastu avasyakatvalakavatvyapicarapavaca natu paksatavacetakananatvasyapi anavasyakatvatkOravatvyapicaraca nanvatrotesyapratitisitirapi nasti tatahi kinatratnatvasananatikaranyena sarvatratnapetavisaya sanuhalanpanarupEka putirutesya uta sarvatrikatvatyutasina tvitiye paranatnani tatapetasitO sitasatananeva nansata sitasatanan sarvatrikatvatyutasinaya eva puterutesyatvena tasya ekatesasitavapi sita(satana)tvat atye katanansata sitasatanan ekatesasitavapyutesyaya sarvatra sanuhalanpanaputerasiteriti cet ucyate utesyapratitisitirapi hi na svarupena sitasatanaprayocika kintu paksatavikatanatvaranunitipratipantakatvenEva taca kvacitsatyasiterapyasti kvacitsatyaniscaye tatanse santehasityapavayorasanpavena tatupayakatitapaksatavirahat atra ca paranatnani satyasitO tatanse paksatavirahena na sarvatnavisesyaka paranatnapetavisesanaka eka sanuhalanpanarupanunitirityanunitipratipantakataya pavatyevanse
